# mtncloud_cypher_secret

Provides an MTN Cloud Cypher secret resource: a value stored under `secret/` in Cypher, the tenant's secrets store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_cypher_secret" "tf_example_cypher_secret" {
  key   = "apipassword"
  value = "password123"
  ttl   = 86400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The path of the cypher secret, excluding the secret prefix
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The value of the cypher secret

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) The time to live of the cypher secret

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the cypher secret

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# By the entry's ID (shown in the console), or by its key, with or without the mount.
terraform import mtncloud_cypher_secret.tf_example_cypher_secret 1
terraform import mtncloud_cypher_secret.tf_example_cypher_secret secret/app/db
# A key made only of digits needs its mount, or it is read as an ID.
terraform import mtncloud_cypher_secret.tf_example_cypher_secret secret/2024
```
